title: Broken arm: cause decides cover; side question about the speaker; back to the pending question

turns.user: Kai broke his arm yesterday. Can we claim for it?
turns.visible:
I’m sorry Kai was hurt. Kai’s SunHaven Family Accident Guard lists a Fracture benefit (per fracture) of an amount that is only shown after claim evidence has been reviewed for a child, payable once per fracture confirmed by X-ray and certified by a registered medical practitioner.
How did Kai break his arm?

turns.user: Before that, quick question: what is my deductible on my KestrelShield plan?
turns.visible:
Your KestrelShield Integrated Plan lists a deductible of S$3,500 per policy year for private hospital treatment.
When you’re ready, here is the question I was on.
How did Kai break his arm?

turns.user: He fell off his bicycle at the park.
turns.visible:
Thanks for explaining how it happened. Kai’s Fracture benefit (per fracture) is listed as an amount that is only shown after claim evidence has been reviewed for a child, payable once per fracture confirmed by X-ray and certified by a registered medical practitioner.
Has Kai’s arm fracture been confirmed by X-ray and certified by a registered medical practitioner?
